title: Birthday cake with candles with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- cake plate -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='84' rx='42' ry='8' fill='#4fc3f7'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='38' ry='6' fill='#81d4fa'/>
  
  <!-- bottom cake layer -->
  <rect x='18' y='60' width='64' height='22' rx='5' fill='#ffb74d'/>
  <rect x='18' y='60' width='64' height='5' rx='3' fill='#ffe0b2'/>
  
  <!-- frosting drips bottom -->
  <path d='M18 62 Q23 72 28 62 Q33 74 38 62 Q43 73 48 62 Q53 72 58 62 Q63 74 68 62 Q73 73 78 62 Q81 68 82 62' fill='#f06292' stroke='none'/>
  
  <!-- middle cake layer -->
  <rect x='22' y='44' width='56' height='18' rx='4' fill='#ffcc80'/>
  <rect x='22' y='44' width='56' height='4' rx='2' fill='#fff3e0'/>
  
  <!-- frosting middle -->
  <path d='M22 46 Q27 54 32 46 Q37 55 42 46 Q47 54 52 46 Q57 55 62 46 Q67 54 72 46 Q76 50 78 46' fill='#ba68c8' stroke='none'/>
  
  <!-- top cake layer -->
  <rect x='26' y='30' width='48' height='16' rx='4' fill='#ffb74d'/>
  <rect x='26' y='30' width='48' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ffe0b2'/>
  
  <!-- frosting top -->
  <path d='M26 32 Q31 40 36 32 Q41 41 46 32 Q51 40 56 32 Q61 41 66 32 Q70 37 74 32' fill='#f06292' stroke='none'/>
  
  <!-- smiling face on cake -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='38' r='2.5' fill='#5c3d1a'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='38' r='2.5' fill='#5c3d1a'/>
  <path d='M42 43 Q50 49 58 43' fill='none' stroke='#5c3d1a' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='42' r='2.5' fill='#ff8a80' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='42' r='2.5' fill='#ff8a80' opacity='0.7'/>
  
  <!-- candles -->
  <!-- candle 1 left -->
  <rect x='34' y='14' width='4' height='16' rx='2' fill='#64b5f6'/>
  <rect x='34' y='14' width='4' height='3' rx='1' fill='#bbdefb'/>
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='11' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#ffee58'/>
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='10' rx='1.5' ry='2.5' fill='#fff9c4'/>
  
  <!-- candle 2 center -->
  <rect x='48' y='12' width='4' height='18' rx='2' fill='#81c784'/>
  <rect x='48' y='12' width='4' height='3' rx='1' fill='#c8e6c9'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='9' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#ffee58'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='8' rx='1.5' ry='2.5' fill='#fff9c4'/>
  
  <!-- candle 3 right -->
  <rect x='62' y='14' width='4' height='16' rx='2' fill='#ef5350'/>
  <rect x='62' y='14' width='4' height='3' rx='1' fill='#ffcdd2'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='11' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#ffee58'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='10' rx='1.5' ry='2.5' fill='#fff9c4'/>
  
  <!-- sprinkles -->
  <rect x='30' y='52' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#4fc3f7' transform='rotate(20 32 53)'/>
  <rect x='48' y='55' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#ffee58' transform='rotate(-15 50 56)'/>
  <rect x='62' y='50' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#81c784' transform='rotate(30 64 51)'/>
  <rect x='38' y='66' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#ef5350' transform='rotate(-25 40 67)'/>
  <rect x='56' y='68' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#ce93d8' transform='rotate(15 58 69)'/>
</svg>
